entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Yes?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ummm...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Welcome. Are you here for a counseling[n]session?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, is now a bad time?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Not at all! It's always a good time, so long[n]as I'm not already listening to a student.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'm so glad you're here. Would you[n]care for a snack?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Shall we get started?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Oh—but first, just relax, all right?[n]I'm only here to listen to whatever[n]you wish to talk about.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sure.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Although I really only have one thing[n]on my mind right now, anyway...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Yes, I'd say that makes perfect sense.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But don't force yourself into talking with[n]me. You could even just grab some snacks[n]and be on your way, if you wanted! Haha...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No, it's... it's all right. I know I need to[n]talk to someone about this, anyway.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That is, if you're willing to listen[n]to the super-long story...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I absolutely am. Take all the time[n]you need.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...I see. That's such a horrible thing[n]to do to someone.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yes. That's why I wanted to get even[n]with him... For Shiho.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Mmhm... And?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: At first, I thought Kamoshida ought to[n]face the same fate Shiho was going to[n]put herself through...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Later, I realized that wasn't right.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If he did take his own life, it wouldn't[n]undo Shiho's suffering—in fact, it'd[n]just give him the easy way out.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Is that so? You know, you are quite the[n]wise, level-headed young woman,[n]Takamaki-san.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? Uh, I think you've got the wrong...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Nope—in fact, I think you're wiser than[n]I was at your age. I wasn't anywhere[n]near as mature as you are now.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...It's not like I did anything special,[n]though.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If I hadn't gone through my own share[n]of hell, I don't think I'd be so mature[n]either.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I see... So, what's on your mind now?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Right now? Hmm...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm just hoping Shiho will get better[n]quickly.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We both suffered a lot, but... I just[n]wanna get back to laughing and having[n]fun together like we used to.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: At this point, I don't give a rat's ass about[n]Kamoshida!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Now there's a healthy outlook!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You can't change the past, but you still[n]want to keep your chin up and press[n]onward—is that the gist of it?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, that sounds about right.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I mean, it'd definitely be better if none[n]of this had happened at all, but...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: *chuckle* I definitely agree with you[n]there.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But, it's impossible to wipe every[n]tragedy from history.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If only, right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Everyone would be so much happier[n]if we could actually do that.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...Oh, it seems I lost track of the time.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: We should wrap things up here for[n]today—thank you so much for coming[n]to see me.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh no, thank you! I feel a ton better[n]now that that's all off my chest.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Hah, good to hear it—you deserve it.[n]Feel free to stop by again anytime.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Will do! See you around!
